Attached: 1 image

On the way home from another busy but fantastic @ResearchSoftEng@mastodon.social  #rsecon26 with lots of ideas for the coming year.

Did too many things to mention in one post, but was delighted to pick up the #community training award with @MarionBWeinzierl@mast.hpc.social on behalf of ICCS. We've worked hard for years, especially so in 2026, building and delivering training to change the culture and quality of #research #software. It's great for the team to be recognised
